item.title: RSV in Older Adults Demands Policy Action
item.description: RSV in older adults remains underrecognized, with policy gaps limiting surveillance, vaccination, and prevention across Europe. The post RSV in Older Adults Demands Policy Action appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Advanced Sequencing Reveals New Autism Gene Variants
item.description: Researchers use long-read genome sequencing to uncover hidden autism gene variants, improving understanding of genetic causes and advancing precision diagnostics. The post Advanced Sequencing Reveals New Autism Gene Variants appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Scientists Discover ‘Indispensable’ Protein for Malaria Parasite
item.description: Scientists have discovered a protein, Aurora-related kinase 1, that is “indispensable” for malaria parasite survival. The post Scientists Discover ‘Indispensable’ Protein for Malaria Parasite appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: UKKW 2026: Individualised Haemodiafiltration May Aid Clearance
item.description: A study suggests convection volume in haemodiafiltration may be tailored to patient weight and residual kidney function to optimise middle-molecule clearance. The post UKKW 2026: Individualised Haemodiafiltration May Aid Clearance appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Anti-Emetic Drug Reduces Seizures in Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
item.description: Administration of prochlorperazine or CLP-257 (or its prodrug CLP-290), significantly decreased seizure frequency in vivo, providing further evidence that enhancing KCC2 function could stabilise neuronal networks. The post Anti-Emetic Drug Reduces Seizures in Temporal Lobe Epilepsy appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: UKKW 2026: CKD Study Questions Accuracy of Widely Used eGFR Equations
item.description: A large UK study finds commonly used eGFR equations may overestimate kidney function, potentially delaying chronic kidney disease diagnosis and treatment. The post UKKW 2026: CKD Study Questions Accuracy of Widely Used eGFR Equations appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Weight Loss Drugs May be More Effective in Women than Men
item.description: GLP-1RAs produce greater weight loss results among women than men, a 2026 systematic review and meta-analysis has found. The post Weight Loss Drugs May be More Effective in Women than Men appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: UKKW 2026: Sibeprenlimab Reduces Proteinuria in IgA Nephropathy Trial
item.description: Interim results from the Phase III VISIONARY trial show that sibeprenlimab significantly reduced proteinuria and improved disease biomarkers in patients with IgA nephropathy. The post UKKW 2026: Sibeprenlimab Reduces Proteinuria in IgA Nephropathy Trial appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Ultrasound Characterisation of Uterine Fibroids
item.description: Analysis of fibroid subtypes reveals unique ultrasound patterns and clinical profiles, helping differentiate usual-type from variant uterine fibroids. The post Ultrasound Characterisation of Uterine Fibroids appeared first on European Medical Journal.
